svg.aria-label: The FastAPI backend in layers. The web server and Traefik call the API under /api/v1. Middleware wraps every request. Routes in five groups call core logic and the pure decision engine. The core reads and writes through a repository to ClickHouse, reads aerial photos from S3, and calls Claude for the AI explanation. Outside the request path, data pipelines and a drawn-boundary step, which a person runs, fill ClickHouse. Four pieces are not built.
svg.title: AgroCycle backend architecture, overview
svg.text: Solid green: built and merged. Amber: a step a person runs, outside the API. Grey: external service. Dashed red: not built.
calls the API from the server;
api/main.py · everything under /api/v1, docs at the root
api/routes · 27 endpoints in five groups; the full list is at /docs
api/core and engine/ · no I/O except through the repository
pure Python, no I/O, no model: the same field and answers always give the same result.
Returns worth exploring, a comparison with caveats, or not enough evidence. Never a score, ranking or winner.
writes: analyses, ask log, drawn fields, feedback
USDA data into S3 and ClickHouse.
a person runs it per saved field:
NASA POWER + USDA soil, then rows
